entries.final_answer: Operator rulings ('Bigger: items 1-6', relayed by the dispatcher, verified in the research squad transcript, ledger R68): (1) a re-pin follows the recorded planning commit by patch-id (reuse consolidation/git_probes.patch_id_of and lanes/planning_base.resolve_finalize_planning_base); (2) it refuses with a named code when there is no match, and never lands on a tip that empties the evidence window; (3) a derived pin is frozen against a later plain finalize; (4) derivation walks the mission branch; (5) #7297 items 3-6 are in scope (message mismatches, too-early pin, too-late pin after a rename, doctor gaps), each grounded before planning; (6) amend ADR 2026-10-04-5. Runner recommendation pending dispatcher confirmation: the single_branch pin's branch line is meta.mission_branch for capture, refresh/repin and derivation alike.
